programmes.d: Pub landlady Hannah Altman is crushed to death by a giant Perspex box during a magic show by famous illusionist Gideon Latimer.

Artist Suzie Colebrook is electrocuted by a roulette wheel shortly after discovering a break-in at her home in Luxton Deeping.

Barnaby and Jones investigate whether competition between ornithology enthusiasts led to murder.

A four-member syndicate owns a racehorse that two of them are desperate to sell and two of them are determined to keep. When one of them is murdered, Barnaby is on the case.

The Midsomer Rocks festival is due to take place and music fans descend on neighbouring fields to enjoy the fiesta. A trendy organic bakery in a restored mill is causing resentment among several villagers.

When popular GP, Doctor Alan Delaney borrows fellow Dr. James Kirkwood's new car to do an evening call-out. He is mysteriously killed in a hit and run during a drive through woods in a thunderstorm. When a barrister is killed, suspicion falls on convicted killer Grady Felton. Barnaby suspects he is working with an accomplice – until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

When a survivalist is found murdered in his bombproof shelter, Barnaby unravels a dark conspiracy.

The inhabitants of Midsomer Magna are in the spotlight, quite literally when a production crew descend on the village and imposing Manor House. To film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. When a man is killed, Barnaby and Winter must investigate if a myth has become murderous reality.

In the village of Midsomer Holm, a rehabilitation scheme for reformed criminals continues. When Ronnie Tyler departs, he gets a good send off from everyone, including DCI Barnaby. Causton is buzzing at the opening of a new brewery on the site of a famously cursed Abbey.
Barnaby and Troy, with an actor tagging along for research, investigate a slashed painting at a museum, which later turns out to be the site of a murder.
Barnaby and Winter are thrust into a crime that impacts not only on their community, but internationally.
When a man is murdered during the reopening of a village, Barnaby and his new partner (Nick Hendrix, "Captain America") must unravel a sinister web of lies in order to catch the killer.
Carver Valleys comic festival is in full swing when the village is shocked by the murder of a former model.
A film historian writing about a 1960s horror actress is killed in her home. It becomes the start of what appear to be a series of copycat murders based on the actress' films.
A death at the local Rugby Club sends Barnaby and Winter into a muddle of rucks.
When a famous 1860 bare-knuckle boxing bout is restaged with great pomp in Midsomer Morchard, dead bodies begin to pile up.
Barnaby is less than impressed when Sarah drags him to a family friends wedding.
Someone is killing off bell ringers of the parish church in the week before a big bell-ringing competition takes place in the village of Midsomer Wellow.
Things take a gruesome turn when Ferrabees Circus comes to town.
When a corporate giant tries to acquire a small but respected relish factory owned and run by a dysfunctional family, a naked body is found in the warehouse.
